C1274.title: Registering Another's Trademark as a Domain Name Without Justification Constitutes Unfair Competition
C1274.summary: In a dispute between a U.S. company and Shanghai Chenmou Intelligent Technology Development Co., Ltd., the defendant registered a domain name incorporating the 'safeguard' trademark, likely causing public confusion about its affiliation with the trademark owner.
